description: This file 'settings.cpp' is a source code file for a firmware project, responsible for configuration and control of engine parameters, sensor inputs, and hardware interface via console commands.

classes.name: Logging
classes.description: A class for managing logging operations within the firmware, used extensively for status output and debugging.

methods.name: printFloatArray
methods.description: Prints the contents of a float array with a specified prefix and formatting.

methods.name: printOutputs
methods.description: Logs the current configuration of engine output pins and modes.

methods.name: printConfiguration
methods.description: Outputs a detailed, human-readable description of the current engine configuration.

methods.name: printTemperatureInfo
methods.description: Prints current temperature sensor readings and related diagnostics.

methods.name: printTPSInfo
methods.description: Prints current throttle position sensor data.

methods.name: doPrintConfiguration
methods.description: Triggers printing of the engine configuration to the console.

methods.name: setFixedModeTiming
methods.description: Sets fixed timing parameters and updates configuration display.

methods.name: setTimingMode
methods.description: Changes the timing mode and updates configuration display.

methods.name: setEngineType
methods.description: Changes engine type setting and resets configuration accordingly.

methods.name: setIdleSolenoidFrequency
methods.description: Adjusts the frequency of the idle solenoid.

methods.name: setInjectionPinMode
methods.description: Sets the mode of injection pins.

methods.name: setIgnitionPinMode
methods.description: Sets the mode of ignition pins.

methods.name: setIdlePinMode
methods.description: Sets the mode for idle control pin.
